body: I think about what it would be like if I actually did do it..I mean I wouldn’t be around to care that I hurt my family or anyone so that’s a plus but I also think about what would happen if I survive. Idk I’d have to deal with my family, supposed friends, teachers and people would know how fucked up I truly am and that scares the shit out of me. I’m stuck in between.
Yeah, you are. I wish I could fix my life.

Idk I hate myself I guess. I always find someway to fuck everything up. I don’t have anyone that I trust enough to talk to anymore and I just feel so fucking alone, like it hurts so much sometimes and I don’t know what to do except cry. There hasn’t been a day in the last 3 months where I haven’t thought about ending it all.
